question: In which of the following states is the Bhadaravi Poonam Mela organised every year in the Nilkanth Mahadev temple premises in Babra?
solution:
The correct answer is __**4) Gujarat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Bhadaravi Poonam Mela** is an annual festival held in the premises of the **Nilkanth Mahadev Temple in Babra, Gujarat**.
 
• This mela (fair) is celebrated with great enthusiasm, primarily during the auspicious occasion of **Bhadarvi Poonam**, which typically occurs in the Hindu month of Bhadrapada (August-September).
 
• Devotees from across Gujarat and neighboring states visit the temple to seek blessings of Lord Shiva during this fair.
 
• The fair is renowned for its vibrant cultural activities, including folk music, dance performances, and traditional rituals dedicated to Lord Shiva.
 
• The mela also serves as an important platform for showcasing local handicrafts, food, and other cultural elements unique to the region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bhadarvi Poonam:**

 
 
• It marks the full moon day in the Hindu month of Bhadrapada, which is considered auspicious for spiritual activities and temple visits.
 
• This day is significant in many parts of India for worshipping deities, especially Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati.
 
 
 
• **Nilkanth Mahadev Temple:**
 
 
• The temple is dedicated to Lord Shiva, often referred to as Nilkanth (the blue-throated one).
 
• It is a major pilgrimage site in Babra, Gujarat, and attracts thousands of devotees during the fair.
 
 
 
• **Fairs and Festivals in Gujarat:**
 
 
• Gujarat is known for its vibrant fairs and festivals, such as Navratri, Rann Utsav, and Shamlaji Fair.
 
• These events highlight the state’s rich culture, traditions, and heritage.
 
 
 
• **Role of Cultural Fairs:**
 
 
• Cultural fairs like Bhadaravi Poonam Mela play a crucial role in preserving local traditions and fostering communal harmony.
 
• They also contribute to the local economy by promoting tourism and handicrafts.
